style_fixes: Removed all em dashes (method_card steps+content, exam_context.frequency, worked_examples step labels 'Step N —' -> 'Step N:'). Trimmed method_card to 4 steps and <140-word content. opener_concept: Kinetic energy v-squared insight: two identical cars, 15 mph vs 30 mph. Student answers the speed ratio (2x) by common sense, then computes 2 squared = 4, and the reveal names E_k = 1/2 m v^2 (four times the energy, four times the damage).
notes: Ladder matches bronze(one equation, right units)/silver(convert or rearrange)/gold(two-step) with no reordering needed. Unit-conversion boxes added as their own step wherever given units are non-base (mins->s, g->kg, kW->W, MW->W, J->kJ). Every walk ends with a check step; completion boundary tagged phase:'substitute' at the compute/interpret stage with >=2 live boxes after. All equation_hint, unit, accept fields preserved. No higher_only content in this lesson (energy/KE/GPE/power are core F+H). No circuit/chart figures: all problems are pure-formula (spec: no decoration on pure-formula). Standard-form turbine problem given a numeric guided walk ending on coefficient 1.296 and power 11.
